title: Outside the mall
content: Has anyone else escaped the mall? For me inside the mall is usually a maze of never ending halls and doors (some locked). Sometimes, I'm able to find a door or window out of the mall. I try to practice directed dreaming and also have PLMD, so my sleeping is often light or interrupted. Outside is a nightmare, but I am always so driven to get out of the mall. Outside is a wasteland of rusted fallen metal structures, rotting wood, putrid bodies of water, people with powers ready to fight to the death (I wonder if they are other directed or lucid dreamers--I call them "independents"), people I've known who've passed away, and groups of people trying to catch independents. Sometimes, outside is a large city like NYC or Chicago. Sometimes it's a small town near a body of water with run down buildings and rotting plywood over the roads. There's often one working train that leads somewhere. I've only made it onto trains a few times before waking up. They are very Amtrak-like (which blue cloth seats). Anyone else get outside?
